input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and operate in any field or territory, and confirms we have given no non-compete commitment. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) and benefits us. A full-text scan for "compet", field-of-use and "Customer shall not" language found no restriction binding us: the only competition reference (§ 24.2) restricts Vendor's assignment to our competitors, and § 13.4 is a standard acceptable-use limit on the Services rather than a field-of-use restriction on our business. The "sole and exclusive provider" language in § 2.2 is an exclusivity commitment addressed under the EXCLUSIVITY rule and is not double-flagged here; § 12.4's post-term non-solicit is likewise a no-hire issue outside this rule.
